typography.font_setup_instructions: Import Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans. Use them across the application.
typography.rules: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for an industrial, precise aesthetic. H1 maximum size is text-5xl with tracking-tight. Labels must be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Tactical Minimalism
colors.background: zinc-950 (#09090b) - True Grey Base to reduce eye strain
colors.surface: zinc-900 (#18181b) - Layered elevation without excessive borders
colors.primary_accent: orange-500 (#f97316) - For low-stock alerts and critical actions
colors.success_accent: emerald-500 (#10b981) - For positive metrics and revenue
colors.ai_accent: blue-500 (#3b82f6) - For AI insights and predictive upsells
colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Use single saturated accents against a desaturated system. Hover states MUST explicitly set text color and background. No generic full-screen gradients.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Layered Elevation. Use Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px inner borders (border-white/5). No muddy gray transparency.
visual_enhancers.ai_panel: Use 'The Tracing Beam' strategy for the AI Insights panel to signal active technology without clutter.
visual_enhancers.borders: Borderless Cards where possible, relying on elevation tokens (bg-zinc-900 vs bg-zinc-950) or Grid Borders (border-collapse style) for dense data tables.

components.cards: Cardless or subtle 4px rounded corners (rounded-sm) with flat solid backgrounds.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Dense padding (p-2 or p-3). Zebra striping using bg-zinc-900/50 for alternate rows. Left-align data, right-align numbers/currency.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, Form. Never native inputs.
components.date_picker: Use Shadcn calendar (NOT HTML input type='date').
components.charts: Use Recharts. Line charts for sales trends, horizontal bars for product consumption. Tooltips must have dark bg-zinc-900 backgrounds to match the theme.

grids.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics).
grids.rules: Grid items must be direct children. Utilize h-full to stretch children. Apply Modified F-Pattern: KPIs top-left, Charts bottom/right.

layouts.dashboard: Sidebar navigation (w-64) + Main content area. Top header with Page Title, Last Updated timestamp, and quick action (e.g., 'New Invoice').
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy for layout containers (p-6 or p-8), tight spacing for dense tables/data grids.
layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, labels, and dense content. Right-align numeric values in tables.

motion.rules: Minimalist - use micro-interactions for feedback. Hover states on all interactive elements (lift -translate-y-1 + subtle shadow).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out). DO NOT use transition-all.
motion.loading: Use Skeleton Screens while data loads to preserve spatial structure and reduce perceived load time.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use text-zinc-400 for secondary, text-zinc-50 for primary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboards. (Install: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).
media.image_usage: Limit images in the dashboard. Use product images strictly for the catalog.
media.empty_states: Use subtle line-art icons and clear text for empty states (e.g., 'No low stock items').

3d_libraries.decision: Not required for this B2B dashboard. Focus on fast 2D data visualization using Recharts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a data-dense, dark-themed dashboard tailored for a Canadian fabrication tools supplier. Prioritize high legibility, using 'True Grey' (zinc) backgrounds over pure black. Emphasize low-stock alerts with orange/red accents. Use the 'Bento Grid Protocol' (Mode B) for dashboard widgets. The AI Insights panel should visually stand out slightly (e.g., a subtle border glow). Use Recharts for all graphs. Implement a sidebar navigation. All components must be accessible and responsive. DO NOT use generic center-aligned layouts. The project uses .js files, so generate .js code. Every interactive element needs a data-testid.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends. Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). You MUST NOT center align the app container. Use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for outer containers. Subtle grain textures or noise overlays can separate good from extraordinary. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters. Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Use sonner for toasts (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js). All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
